reviewCriteria: Stroller gate width and continuous step-free route; contact companion, establish platform and reunion point before following.
Moving-in address: contract versus self-abbreviated delivery note; do not guess building name, applicant opens envelope, one applicant and missing-document check.
Two medical appointments: institution and date/time identity, self-entry error, unavailable mornings, clinician approval before rescheduling and separate slips.

Missing bicycle: photograph is one month old at home, basket changed from small white to large black; today’s side-wall row and pillar sign are separate from photo location; 13:00 parking and about14:00 return.
sourceIssues: Gendered locale voices are retained pending character-profile policy; not native certification.
storage: Additive receipt; previous receipt files retained byte-for-byte.
